description: Minimal RegressGuard Quickstart case set. One case per assertion type (exact, contains, regex). Runs against the bundled `stub` provider so no API key is required. Full schema: .agent/eval-schema.md

cases.input: Return only the string 'ok' with no punctuation or whitespace.
Explain briefly why parameterized SQL queries prevent injection.
cases.expected: A short explanation mentioning that parameters are sent separately from the SQL text.

cases.input: Give me a US phone number in the format 555-123-4567.
cases.expected: A string matching the North American 3-3-4 hyphenated format.
